command:
set -eu
tool=/app/toolchain/node22-source-min
if [ ! -x "$tool/bin/node" ]; then
  work=$(mktemp -d /data/tmp/node22-source-min.XXXXXX)
  trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
  cd "$work"
  curl --fail --location --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 120 -o node-v22.18.0-linux-arm64.tar.xz https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.18.0/node-v22.18.0-linux-arm64.tar.xz
  curl --fail --location --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 -o SHASUMS256.txt https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.18.0/SHASUMS256.txt
  grep ' node-v22.18.0-linux-arm64.tar.xz$' SHASUMS256.txt | sha256sum --check
  mkdir -p "$tool"
  tar -xJf node-v22.18.0-linux-arm64.tar.xz --strip-components=1 -C "$tool"
fi
cd /app/project
"$tool/bin/node" --version
# Build source fixture with the actual wrapper and source CLI; no dist exists.
work=$(mktemp -d /data/tmp/launcher-source-min.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
cp package.json *.ts "$work/"
cp -R bin src "$work/"
ln -s /app/cache/node_modules "$work/node_modules"
set +e
"$tool/bin/node" "$work/bin/git-warp" --help > "$work/help.out" 2> "$work/help.err"
status=$?
set -e
cat "$work/help.err"
test "$status" -eq 0
test -s "$work/help.out"
test ! -s "$work/help.err"
set +e
"$tool/bin/node" "$work/bin/git-warp" no-such-command > "$work/unknown.out" 2> "$work/unknown.err"
status=$?
set -e
test "$status" -eq 1
test ! -s "$work/unknown.out"
grep -q 'Unknown command' "$work/unknown.err"
echo MINIMUM_NODE_22_18_ACTUAL_SOURCE_HELP_AND_USAGE_PASS
du -s -B1 /app/toolchain/node22-source-min /app/toolchain/node22-min
guard: inner guard plus outer host free/log monitor; read-only container root
